modalities.evidence: Contrast-enhanced spectral mammography (CESM) images with annotations and medical reports
Full medical reports are also provided for each case (DOCX)

output.population: Patients examined with contrast-enhanced spectral mammography after intravenous iodinated contrast injection
output.summary: Contrast-enhanced spectral mammography images acquired in craniocaudal and mediolateral oblique views at low and high energy, converted to JPEG, with full medical reports and manual segmentation annotations of abnormal findings.
